summary: Round-7 testing for AbodeOps: Command Center metrics, Operations Feed activity, job add-ons, applicant match_score (Best Match), $99 Business subscription, empty-state CTAs and renamed labels (Work Hub / Create Job / Command Center). Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_round7_features.py with 10 tests covering /api/metrics RBAC+values, /api/activity (list shape + appended-on-create), /api/jobs/{id}/addon (poster authz + idempotent $addToSet + activity log), match_score in /api/jobs/{id} (0-99, sorted desc), /api/billing/checkout for business ($9900 -> checkout_url) and pro and invalid-tier rejection. ALL 10/10 PASSED. Verified: cleaner role gets 403 on /metrics; owner metrics keys all present and completed_total>=2 (seed). /api/activity returns {kind,text,job_id,created_at,activity_id,job_title}; after POST /api/jobs the new 'created' kind appears at the top. POST /api/jobs/demojob_1/addon as owner returns the enriched job with 'Oven' in addons, idempotent (no duplicate), and an 'addon' activity is logged. GET /api/jobs/demojob_2 as owner after cleaner applies returns applicants_info each with match_score 0-99, sorted descending (Casey Cleaner=98%). POST /api/billing/checkout {tier:'business', redirect_url} returns checkout_url that starts http (Stripe checkout) — Stripe logs confirm a real session was created. Invalid tier 'free' is rejected with 422. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): (1) OWNER dashboard renders 'Create Job' button (testID post-job-button), 'Command Center' card (testID operations-card) and 'Work Hub' tab — all three renamed labels confirmed. (2) Tapping operations-card -> /operations -> header 'Command Center', 2x2 metrics grid renders $180 Revenue today / $300 Payroll owed / 0 Active cleaners / 2 Done today; Operations Feed section with pulse icon + 'LIVE' badge + 11 feed rows (kinds: created/addon/completed/arrived) each showing relative time (1m/2m/6m/17m/32m). Tapping the first feed row navigated to /job/demojob_1 — feed->job nav confirmed. (3) /subscription page: hero header 'Run your entire cleaning operation', AbodeOps Business badge, 3 tier cards (free/pro/business) all with testIDs tier-free/tier-pro/tier-business, Business shows price $99/month, 'MOST POPULAR' ribbon, full premium feature list (Live Crew Map, Team management, Onboarding/SOPs, Command Center, Payroll & tax previews, Unlimited messaging, Client list & feedback, Priority support — all keywords matched). Tapping 'Upgrade to Business' (testID upgrade-business) triggered a real navigation to https://checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_... — Stripe checkout flow integration verified. (4) /job/demojob_2 as owner (after cleaner@abodeops.com applied via API): Applicants section shows 'Casey Cleaner' with green 'Best Match: 98%' badge (top applicant). 'Add-on Services' card shows + Oven / + Fridge / + Windows / + Laundry / + Garage / + Carpet chips (testID addon-Oven etc.). Tapping addon-Oven posted to /jobs/demojob_2/addon and the UI updated: 'Oven' moved to an active chip with green check icon, and the remaining chips re-rendered as 5 add-ables (Fridge/Windows/Laundry/Garage/Carpet). (5) Empty-state CTA: registered a brand-new company_owner with zero jobs, logged in, saw stats 0/0/0 and the EmptyState card with title 'No active jobs' + actionLabel 'Create Job' (testID dash-empty-cta) — clicking it navigated to /post-job. (6) Renamed labels: 'Work Hub' tab confirmed for owner role (bottom tab bar), 'Create Job' header+button on /post-job, 'Command Center' on dashboard card + /operations header. No React Native red screens or new console errors. Carried-over warnings still present (shadow* deprecation, expo@54.0.34->54.0.35 SDK drift).

react_native_issues.issue: Console: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' fires repeatedly during web bundling. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/JobMap.tsx:42-44 (pin/person shadow* props) plus shadow* usage elsewhere. Migrate to boxShadow.
Expo CLI warns: expo@54.0.34→~54.0.35, expo-font@14.0.11→~14.0.12, expo-router@6.0.23→~6.0.24. Run `npx expo install --check` to align. Reference: /var/log/supervisor/expo.err.log.

critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py L1230-1254 /metrics: revenue_today and payroll_owed both fall back to estimated_duration*pay_rate when logged_pay is missing — for completed jobs this is fine, but if a job is completed with logged_pay set, payroll_owed correctly uses logged_pay while revenue_today still uses the estimate. Consider unifying so revenue_today also prefers logged_pay (or document the semantic gap). Not blocking; numbers in UI are consistent with seed.

/app/backend/server.py L1259-1269 POST /jobs/{id}/addon uses $addToSet (good: idempotent) and logs activity AFTER the update — order is correct. Note: AddonIn has only a 'name' field with no max-length / sanitization. Consider name: constr(min_length=1, max_length=40) to prevent garbage strings being injected into the activity feed.

/app/backend/server.py L1222-1227 /activity returns 40 items unconditionally and is poster-scoped — fine. No pagination param; for high-volume owners this will eventually grow large. Consider adding ?limit & ?before query params.

/app/backend/server.py L455-474 match_score is a deterministic heuristic capped 20-99. The capped-99 ceiling means even the perfect cleaner never shows 100%, which matches the UI's '98% fit / Best Match: 98%' look — intentional.
/app/backend/server.py L36 TIER_PRICING.business=9900 ✓ and STRIPE_PRICE lookup_key abodeops_business_monthly_9900 is correctly wired.

/app/frontend/app/operations.tsx L46-56 load() calls 4 endpoints in parallel and silently swallows errors — if /metrics 403s (cleaner viewing) the page renders with $0/$0/0/0 instead of a friendly 'Owner only' message. Consider role-gating navigation to /operations from the dashboard.
/app/frontend/app/subscription.tsx L46-66 checkout flow correctly uses res.checkout_url (not res.url) per the contract. On web it forces window.location.href — confirmed redirect to Stripe.

/app/frontend/app/job/[id].tsx L176 addon chip uses testID `addon-${ad}` — works. The list of addable services is hardcoded in the component; consider moving to backend-config so add-ons can be edited without a frontend deploy.

success_rate.backend: 100% (10/10 round-7 tests). /metrics RBAC+values, /activity list+append, /jobs/{id}/addon authz+idempotent+activity-logged, match_score sorted desc 0-99, billing checkout business+pro+invalid all verified.
success_rate.frontend: 100% on all 5 round-7 flows. Command Center (metrics grid + Operations Feed LIVE + feed-row→job nav) ✓. Subscription (hero, $99 Business, MOST POPULAR ribbon, full feature list, Upgrade to Business→Stripe redirect) ✓. Job detail (Best Match: 98% badge + addon-Oven chip click → active chip + persisted) ✓. Empty-state CTA (dash-empty-cta → /post-job) ✓. Renamed labels (Work Hub / Create Job / Command Center) all present.
